name: Labor contract negotiation
description: A union and a firm bargain over wages, benefits and a job guarantee with alternating offers, strikes and lockouts, a mediator from round 7, and a hard deadline.

brief.situation: The collective agreement at a manufacturing plant has expired. The union and the firm are bargaining over a new three-part contract: a wage increase (0 to 8%), a benefits package (basic, standard, enhanced or premium) and a job guarantee (0 to 5 years). A neutral mediator is available from round 7.
brief.rules: Bargaining uses alternating offers: the union moves in odd rounds, the firm in even rounds. On your move you may accept the other side's standing offer (the contract is signed immediately) or table a counter-offer that replaces it. The union may call a strike and the firm may declare a lockout; while either lasts, both sides lose the stated cost every round until the side that started it calls it off or a contract is signed. From round 7 the mediator may table one compromise proposal; both sides answer it in a sealed vote and it is signed only if both accept. There is a hard deadline: with no contract by then, each side takes its walk-away value minus everything the dispute cost it. Each side scores a contract from 0 to 100 points using its own private priorities; neither side knows the other's priorities or walk-away value.

roles.union_rep: You are the union's chief negotiator. Your members gain from a higher wage increase, better benefits and a longer job guarantee. Your goal is the highest score for the union after dispute costs. A contract below your walk-away value leaves members worse off than no deal.
roles.firm_rep: You are the firm's chief negotiator. The firm gains from a lower wage increase, leaner benefits and a shorter job guarantee. Your goal is the highest score for the firm after dispute costs. A contract below your walk-away value leaves the firm worse off than no deal.
roles.mediator: You are the neutral mediator. You do not know either side's priorities or walk-away values; you see only what they table. Your goal is a signed contract both sides can live with. From round 7 you may table exactly one compromise proposal, so time it and shape it well.

union_reservation.description: What the union is worth with no contract (walk-away value), on the union's 0-100 scale. Private to the union.

firm_reservation.description: What the firm is worth with no contract (walk-away value), on the firm's 0-100 scale. Private to the firm.

strike_cost.description: What each side loses for every round a strike or lockout lasts.

deadline.description: Last round of bargaining. With no signed contract by then, both sides take their walk-away value minus dispute costs.

wage_cap.description: Largest wage increase on the table (%).

years_cap.description: Longest job guarantee on the table (years).

flip.description: 0: more is better for this side; 1: less is better.

with.message: Our members will not accept less.

flip.description: 0: more is better for this side; 1: less is better.

with.message: Both of you have moved. This splits the difference on every issue.

table_talk.description: What negotiators say across the table alongside their moves.

accept_offer.description: Accept the other side's standing offer. The contract is signed on those terms immediately and any strike or lockout ends.

when.why: Nothing is on the table yet. Table an offer with counter_offer.
The standing offer is your own. Wait for the other side, or table a new one.

accept_offer.outcome: You accepted: wage +{$world.deal_wage|1}%, {$world.deal_benefits} benefits, {$world.deal_years}-year job guarantee. The contract is signed; it scores {$actor.deal_value|1} points for you.
accept_offer.announce: {$actor.name} accepted the standing offer. Contract signed: wage +{$world.deal_wage|1}%, {$world.deal_benefits} benefits, {$world.deal_years}-year job guarantee.

counter_offer.description: Table a full contract offer. It replaces the standing offer and the other side answers on its next move.

wage.description: Wage increase in percent (0 to 8, one decimal).

message.description: Optional short statement to the other side.

counter_offer.outcome: You tabled: wage +{$world.offer_wage|1}%, {$params.benefits} benefits, {$params.years}-year job guarantee. For you it scores {$actor.offer_value|1} points (walk-away {$actor.reservation|1}).
counter_offer.announce: {$actor.name} tabled an offer: wage +{$world.offer_wage|1}%, {$params.benefits} benefits, {$params.years}-year job guarantee.

call_strike.description: Call a strike. From this round on, both sides lose the dispute cost every round until you end it or a contract is signed. You can still table or accept an offer this turn.

when.why: A dispute is already under way.

call_strike.outcome: The union is on strike. Both sides now lose {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points per round.
call_strike.announce: The union has called a strike. Both sides lose {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points per round while it lasts.

end_strike.description: Call off the strike; members return to work.

when.why: There is no strike to end.

end_strike.announce: The union has called off its strike.

call_lockout.description: Declare a lockout. From this round on, both sides lose the dispute cost every round until you lift it or a contract is signed. You can still table or accept an offer this turn.

when.why: A dispute is already under way.

call_lockout.outcome: The plant is locked out. Both sides now lose {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points per round.
call_lockout.announce: The firm has declared a lockout. Both sides lose {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points per round while it lasts.

end_lockout.description: Lift the lockout; the plant reopens.

when.why: There is no lockout to lift.

end_lockout.announce: The firm has lifted its lockout.

propose_compromise.description: Table your one compromise proposal. Both sides then vote on it in secret; it is signed only if both accept.

when.why: The mediator can only intervene from round 7.
You have already used your one proposal.

wage.description: Wage increase in percent (0 to 8, one decimal).

message.description: Optional short rationale addressed to both sides.

propose_compromise.outcome: You tabled the compromise: wage +{$world.prop_wage|1}%, {$params.benefits} benefits, {$params.years}-year job guarantee. Both sides now vote.
propose_compromise.announce: The mediator proposes a compromise: wage +{$world.prop_wage|1}%, {$params.benefits} benefits, {$params.years}-year job guarantee. Both sides vote on it now.

vote_on_proposal.description: Accept or reject the mediator's compromise. Votes are sealed; the contract is signed only if both sides accept.

when.why: There is no mediator proposal to vote on.

vote_on_proposal.outcome: You voted to {$params.decision} the mediator's proposal.

stages.name: mediation
stages.brief: You may table your one compromise proposal now, or end your turn and wait for a better moment.

stages.name: mediator_vote
stages.brief: Vote on the mediator's compromise. If you do not vote, it counts as a rejection.

stages.name: bargaining
stages.brief: It is your move. Accept the standing offer or table a counter-offer; you may also start or end a strike or lockout first.

position.title: Your private position
position.show: Walk-away value {reservation|1} points. Priorities: wage {w_wage|pct}, benefits {w_benefits|pct}, job guarantee {w_years|pct}. Dispute costs so far: {costs|1} points.

scoring.title: How a contract scores for you (0-100)
scoring.show: {$text('Wage 0%, basic benefits, 0 years score 0 on each issue; 8%, premium, 5 years score 100.' if $actor.flip == 0 else 'Wage 8%, premium benefits, 5 years score 0 on each issue; 0%, basic, 0 years score 100.')} Benefit steps are a third apart. Your score is the priority-weighted sum.

standing_offer.title: On the table
standing_offer.show: {$entity($world.offer_by).name} offer from round {$world.offer_round}: wage +{$world.offer_wage|1}%, {$world.offer_benefits} benefits, {$world.offer_years}-year job guarantee.

offer_value.show: That offer scores {offer_value|1} points for you ({$text('above') if $actor.offer_value >= $actor.reservation else $text('below')} your walk-away value).

last_offers.title: Latest offers from each side
last_offers.empty: Neither side has tabled an offer yet.

proposal.title: Mediator's compromise
proposal.show: Wage +{$world.prop_wage|1}%, {$world.prop_benefits} benefits, {$world.prop_years}-year job guarantee. It scores {proposal_value|1} points for you (walk-away {reservation|1}).

dispute.title: Industrial action
dispute.show: A {$world.dispute} has been running since round {$world.dispute_since}; it costs each side {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points per round.

clock.show: Hard deadline: end of round {$clock.rounds} ({$clock.rounds - $round} round(s) left). {$text('The mediator can table one proposal from round 7.') if not $world.mediator_used else $text('The mediator has used its proposal.')}

events.name: dispute_costs
events.say: The {$world.dispute} cost each side {$inputs.strike_cost|1} points this round.

events.name: deadline_warning
events.say: Two rounds remain before the hard deadline.

events.name: deadline
events.say: The deadline has passed without a contract. Each side falls back to its walk-away value minus dispute costs.

then.say: Both sides accepted the mediator's compromise. Contract signed: wage +{$world.deal_wage|1}%, {$world.deal_benefits} benefits, {$world.deal_years}-year job guarantee.

else.say: The mediator's compromise was not adopted (union: {$union_vote}, firm: {$firm_vote}). Bargaining continues.

final_wage.description: Wage increase in the signed contract (%).

final_terms.expr: 'wage +' + $text($world.deal_wage) + '%, ' + $text($world.deal_benefits) + ' benefits, ' + $text($world.deal_years) + '-year job guarantee' if $world.deal else 'no contract'

union_utility.description: Union's final score after dispute costs.

firm_utility.description: Firm's final score after dispute costs.

union_surplus.description: Union's gain over its walk-away value.

firm_surplus.description: Firm's gain over its walk-away value.

union_surplus_share.description: Union's share of the joint gain, when both sides gained.

union_offer_value.description: Union's score of the standing offer.

firm_offer_value.description: Firm's score of the standing offer.

wage_gap.description: Distance between the latest wage offers.

end.name: agreement
end.say: A new contract has been signed.

invariants.why: Dispute rounds cannot exceed rounds played.
